query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Implement and release a protected budget dashboard feature by reading Google Sheets and Google Docs data, retrieving deployment secrets from Vercel, committing and merging code changes, verifying deployments, and updating a Jira issue.
query_ground_truth.intent: Check that the newly merged code has successfully built and deployed on Vercel.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if scope is unclear)] [Prerequisite]: Identify the correct scope using VERCEL_GET_TEAMS (reuse the chosen team context in later calls).
[Optional (if project is unknown/ambiguous)] [Prerequisite]: Resolve the project using VERCEL_GET_PROJECTS (retain a stable project identifier for filtering).
[Required] [Step]: Enumerate recent deployments using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS (apply scope/project/branch filters if available; follow pagination.next/prev until the newest relevant item is found).
[Required] [Next Step]: Select the most recent usable deployment from deployments[] using created time plus readyState/state (skip queued/building/errored/blocked when you need a healthy “latest”).

[Required] [Next Step]: Fetch authoritative status/metadata using VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT (use idOrUrl from the chosen deployment uid/url); if non-terminal or aliasAssigned is false, re-call until terminal/assigned when you need the final hostname.
[Optional (if a canonical hostname is needed)] [Next Step]: Retrieve alias(es) using VERCEL_LIST_DEPLOYMENT_ALIASES (can be empty; fall back to URL fields from VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT).

[Required (if deployment is unhealthy or details are missing)] [Fallback]: Diagnose using VERCEL_LIST_DEPLOYMENT_CHECKS (ensure you pass deploymentId), correlate timeline with VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_EVENTS2, and pull runtime evidence via VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_LOGS2 when needed.
known_pitfalls: [VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS] Tool wrappers may nest deployments under results[0].response.data.deployments and pagination under results[0].response.data.pagination.next/prev—verify JSON paths before iterating.
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS] 403 Forbidden can occur when the connection is unauthorized for the chosen scope/team; retry with an authorized scope.
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT] idOrUrl must be a deployment uid or deployment URL; passing other identifiers can 404 “Deployment not found”.
[VERCEL_LIST_DEPLOYMENT_CHECKS] Validation can fail if called without deploymentId (passing idOrUrl may trigger a missing-field error).
[VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_EVENTS2] High-frequency diagnostics (also VERCEL_LIST_DEPLOYMENT_CHECKS and VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT_LOGS2) can trigger HTTP 429—keep requests ~1/sec and honor Retry-After.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Extract a matching project id from a saved JSON payload read from stdin (adjust JSON path to your tool wrapper)
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json,sys
p=json.load(sys.stdin)
ident='PROJECT_KEY'
items=p['results'][0]['response']['data'].get('projects',[])
m=next((x for x in items if x.get('name')==ident or x.get('slug')==ident),None)
print(m.get('id') if m else None)
```

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Extract a compact deployments table (uid, state, createdAt, url) from a saved JSON payload read from stdin
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json,sys
p=json.load(sys.stdin)
items=p['results'][0]['response']['data'].get('deployments',[])
out=[{'uid':d.get('uid'),'state':d.get('readyState') or d.get('state'),'createdAt':d.get('createdAt'),'url':d.get('url')} for d in items]
print(out[:10])
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Vercel is a platform for frontend frameworks and static sites, enabling developers to host websites and web services that deploy instantly, scale automatically, and require minimal configuration.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=vercel. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="vercel") to create a connection BEFORE executing any vercel tools.

VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENTS.description: Tool to list deployments from Vercel. Use when you need to retrieve deployment information for a project or team.

to.description: Gets the deployment created before this Date timestamp. (default: current time)

app.description: Name of the deployment to filter by

sha.description: Filter deployments based on the SHA

from.description: Gets the deployment created after this Date timestamp. (default: current time)

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of

limit.description: Maximum number of deployments to list from a request

since.description: Get Deployments created after this JavaScript timestamp

state.description: Filter deployments based on their state (BUILDING, ERROR, INITIALIZING, QUEUED, READY, CANCELED)

until.description: Get Deployments created before this JavaScript timestamp

users.description: Filter out deployments based on users who have created the deployment

branch.description: Filter deployments based on the branch name

target.description: Filter deployments based on the environment

teamId.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of

projectId.description: Filter deployments from the given ID or name

projectIds.description: Filter deployments from the given project IDs. Cannot be used when projectId is specified

rollbackCandidate.description: Filter deployments based on their rollback candidacy

VERCEL_GET_DEPLOYMENT.description: Tool to get a deployment by ID or URL. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific deployment.

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

teamId.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

idOrUrl.description: The unique identifier or hostname of the deployment.

withGitRepoInfo.description: Whether to add in gitRepo information.

VERCEL_GET_PROJECTS.description: Tool to retrieve a list of projects from Vercel. Use this to get project information with optional filtering by repository, team, or other criteria.

from.description: Query only projects updated after the given timestamp or continuation token.

repo.description: Filter results by repo. Also used for project count.

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

limit.description: Limit the number of projects returned.

search.description: Search projects by the name field.

teamId.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

edgeConfigId.description: Filter results by connected Edge Config ID.

excludeRepos.description: Filter results by excluding those projects that belong to a repo.

staticIpsEnabled.description: Filter results by projects with Static IPs enabled. Use '1' for enabled, '0' for disabled.

buildMachineTypes.description: Filter results by build machine types. Accepts comma-separated values. Use 'default' for projects without a build machine type set.

edgeConfigTokenId.description: Filter results by connected Edge Config Token ID.

gitForkProtection.description: Specifies whether PRs from Git forks should require a team member's authorization before it can be deployed. Use '1' for enabled, '0' for disabled.

elasticConcurrencyEnabled.description: Filter results by projects with elastic concurrency enabled. Use '1' for enabled, '0' for disabled.
